note: Functional requirements merged by the team from the generated ones (Ethan/answers/requirements.json).

requirements.text: The system shall present climate facts in a respectful tone that never lectures the player.
The system shall show the IPCC source (section and page) of every climate fact given in a dialogue.
The system shall never present a claim that contradicts the IPCC report as true.
The system shall let the player choose between several kinds of answers (a fact, a question, an empathetic answer) when talking to a character.
The system shall make the skeptical character react differently to each kind of answer and keep track of how convinced he is.
The system shall let the player ask the character questions that make him reconsider his claim, not only give him facts.
The system shall show the impacts of climate change on the mountain (the disappeared glacier, the weather getting worse with altitude) through the environment and the climb rather than through text.
The system shall offer small optional actions at the base camp that show the effect of individual choices.
The system shall link the player's individual actions to collective action against climate change.
